findings.location:
...Hebreerne kapittel fire.

(Paragraph about magazine contents, third paragraph after Scripture citations)
findings.source_quote: Together we can consider what it really means to enter into the rest of God that is detailed in Hebrews chapter four.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the mistranslation "Guds sabbatstro" with a faithful rendering of "the rest of God", for example: "å gå inn i Guds hvile som er omtalt i Hebreerne kapittel fire." Preserve the existing HTML and surrounding sentence structure when applying the change.
findings.translation_quote: Sammen kan vi vurdere hva det virkelig betyr å gå inn i Guds sabbatstro som er detaljert i Hebreerne kapittel fire.
